properties.title: Fikra Design

overview_description.description:
At FIKRA DESIGN the word "Product Design" is used quite loosely.

Often it refers to the overall process of developing a new product. However, for us at FIKRA design it is all about creating. Whether that is creating a stunning appealing new design or coming up with a solution to wrap together all of the functional needs of a product into one, that’s what Product Design is for us. The Product Design is indeed a major step in the Product Development Process. It is the drawing board that all products emerge from and the reason why the profession of Product Design exists.
